plan.summary: This 4-week block is a simple off-camp boxing S&C build for a beginner with one 45-minute session each week and plenty of room for sparring and skill work. Week 1 establishes a baseline on the main lower-body lift so later loading can stay practical and repeatable. Weeks 2-3 build strength and power with low exercise count, crisp intent, and controlled fatigue. Week 4 deloads by cutting volume while keeping movement quality high. This block starts the 12-week parent cycle, with the main program beginning in Week 2.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish a baseline, then build general lower-body strength and simple explosive qualities without adding much fatigue to boxing work.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power steadily with slightly heavier main work while keeping the session compact and recoverable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it with faster, sharper power work that supports boxing movement.

exercises.name: Box Jump
exercises.notes: Use a low stable box and land softly. Step down each rep. Every jump should look fast and clean.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if no safe box is available. Reset between reps and jump as high as you can with a controlled landing.

substitutionOptions.name: Squat Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bodyweight only. Pause briefly at the bottom and explode up.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few gradual sets, then work up to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. Stop if form breaks. This sets your baseline for the next weeks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate a baseline for future loading.

exercises.name: One-Arm Dumbbell Row
exercises.notes: Drive the elbow back and keep the torso still. Use a load that leaves about 2 reps in reserve.

substitutionOptions.name: Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row

substitutionOptions.name: Band Row
